mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that may prompt central bank intervention, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 7.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and potential earnings headwinds, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and increased residential investment, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has risen for at least two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly job gains exceed 200,000 (PAYEMS > 200000), it signals a robust labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals a monetary tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate below 1.5% annualized), weak consumer demand leads to reduced corporate profit margins and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate is below 1.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.
